rawOutput.title: Use the Product Rule Independently
rawOutput.rationale: This is a conceptual and problem-solving plan. It begins with the meaning and procedure of the product rule, using one complete example before guided attempts. Four short sessions fit the available 15-minute windows and move from teaching to independent retrieval, application, and error repair.

sessions.title: Understand the Product Rule
sessions.objective: Build the product rule from the need to differentiate two multiplied functions.
sessions.amountLabel: One rule and one complete worked example
contentTargets: Recognize a product of two functions and interpret (fg)' = f'g + fg'.
Follow the product rule in one worked polynomial example.
completionEvidence: Explain why differentiating each factor separately and multiplying the results is incorrect.
Apply the product rule to one closely matched example with guidance.

sessions.title: Apply the Procedure Step by Step
sessions.objective: Use the product rule with decreasing guidance.
contentTargets: Identify f, g, f', and g' before substitution.
Differentiate products of polynomial functions and simplify the result.
completionEvidence: Construct a correct f, g, f', and g' setup for one expression.
Solve one polynomial product derivative with only step prompts.

sessions.title: Retrieve and Apply Independently
sessions.objective: Recall the rule and apply it without a displayed template.
sessions.amountLabel: One recall check and two independent derivatives
contentTargets: Recall the product rule from memory.
Apply the rule to two products with different factor forms.
completionEvidence: Recall the product rule accurately without looking.
Solve two product-rule derivatives independently and show the substitution step.

sessions.title: Mixed Check and Error Repair
sessions.objective: Choose the product rule when appropriate and repair any remaining procedural errors.
sessions.amountLabel: Three mixed decisions with one corrected solution
contentTargets: Distinguish product-rule problems from direct power-rule problems.
Check product-rule solutions for missing or incorrectly differentiated terms.
completionEvidence: Classify three derivatives by whether they require the product rule.
Solve one product-rule problem independently and correct any identified error.

activities.concept: Recognize a product of two functions and interpret (fg)' = f'g + fg'.
activities.correctAnswer: The product rule is (fg)' = f'g + fg'. It is used when a derivative is taken of two functions multiplied together.
activities.feedback: A complete response names the rule and the situation that calls for it. A common gap is to treat the derivative of a product as the product of the derivatives.

activities.title: Product rule recognition
activities.body: Choose the correct derivative rule for a product. Select one answer.
activities.concept: Recognize a product of two functions and interpret (fg)' = f'g + fg'.
activities.feedback: The product rule adds two terms, one for each factor differentiated once. The other choices confuse products with sums, or with multiplying derivatives.
